mitrich.profile: Mitrich — an old, kind Russian village neighbour in his 60s in an ushanka, hoarse warm voice, sly and funny.
mitrich.notes: Line 1: surprised, friendly, over the fence early in the morning; say «Федька» very clearly: «ФЕДЬ-ка». Line 2: matter-of-fact, a bit proud of his grandson. Line 3: cheerful, sly bargaining.
